bundles.title: Schema foundation for search, retrieve and match (merge into the single M0 schema bundle)
schema:
new model RASkill (new file server/prisma/schema/ra-skills.prisma):
model RASkill {
  /// Stable slug, e.g. 'postgresql', 'relational_databases', 'cpa'.
  id             String   @id
  /// 'hard' | 'soft' | 'certification'
  kind           String   @default("hard")
  labelEn        String
  labelZh        String?
  labelZhHant    String?
  /// Comparison keys (features/match/terms.ts termKey form) of every label and alias in any script.
  aliases        String[] @default([])
  /// Broader skill this one is evidence for (postgresql -> relational_databases).
  parentId       String?
  esco           String?
  onet           String?
  /// 'reviewed' | 'unreviewed' (unreviewed skills are shown, never scored).
  status         String   @default("unreviewed")
  mentionCount   Int      @default(0)
  /// Label vector, written with raw SQL; embeddingModel says which model produced it.
  embedding      Unsupported("halfvec(1024)")?
  embeddingModel String?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt
  @@index([aliases], type: Gin)
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([status, mentionCount(sort: Desc)])
}

new models (new file server/prisma/schema/ra-retrieval.prisma); rows are read and written with $queryRaw / $executeRaw only:
model RAJobEmbedding {
  jobId       String   @id
  job         RAJob    @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  market      String
  /// e.g. 'openai/text-embedding-3-small@1024'
  model       String
  /// sha1 of the embedded card text
  contentHash String
  embedding   Unsupported("halfvec(1024)")
  embeddedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([market, model])
}
model RAUserEmbedding {
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  market     String
  /// 'intent' (onboarding and search answers) | 'resume' (primary resume)
  kind       String
  model      String
  sourceHash String
  embedding  Unsupported("halfvec(1024)")
  updatedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  @@id([userId, market, kind])
}
plus the back-relation line in model User (server/prisma/schema/legacy.prisma): raUserEmbeddings RAUserEmbedding[]

raw SQL, new file server/prisma/sql/001_vector.sql (run once per database by the owner BEFORE the push, like 000_extensions.sql): CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;   -- nothing else: tables and indexes are declared in the Prisma schema because prisma db push drops what the schema does not declare

SR-16b-1 needs no new declaration: RAJob.lastSeenQueryId, RAJob.lastSeenRun and RAIngestQuery.runCount are already in ra-jobs.prisma (marked SCHEMA-2); the M0 push creates them when the branch database lacks them (features/jobs/ingest/tracking.ts probes information_schema for the three columns).

env: EVAL_LIVE: 1 allows "npm run eval:match -- --live" to read the database (read-only) and call models; anything else refuses (unset)
EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL: model id of the relevance judge for --live; must differ from the resolved LLM_MATCHING_MODEL (unset: --live refuses to judge)

New vitest.eval.config.mts: same resolve aliases and closed-port DATABASE_URL / DIRECT_DATABASE_URL as vitest.config.mts (the env block at lines 29-32), environment node, include only server/src/features/match/eval/**/*.eval.ts, so the specs are NOT picked up by "npm test" (whose include is **/*.test.ts). [P0] Metric functions and the gate table of strategy 2.6 (SM-1; strategy 2.6; MATCH 6.2)
CHANGE: New eval/metrics.ts, pure functions: recallAtK(ranked ids, labels, k, minGrade = 2); ndcgAtK (gain 2^grade - 1, log2 discount); weightedKappa (quadratic weights, for tiers and for judge against human grades); icc (two-way random, absolute agreement, single measure) over repeated scorer runs; spearman; precision and recall per class (for shown / related / not shown); tierFlipRate over runs; reliabilityCurve (mean AI score per estimate decile); shareEstimateGreatAiBelowPossible. New eval/gates.ts, data only, one entry per layer with the numbers of strategy 2.6: retrieval: Recall@200 hybrid >= recency-only + 15 points and no persona more than 5 points below its baseline; ranking: NDCG@10 and NDCG@20 no regression against fixtures/baselines.json (written by --write-baseline); estimate against AI: tier kappa >= 0.5 and "estimate Great, AI below Possible" under 5%; scorer: ICC >= 0.85 over 3 runs, tier flips under 5%, Spearman with human grades >= 0.6; taxonomy: category precision >= 95% on 300 labelled titles per market; skills: precision of "Not shown" >= 95%; language: zh-TW, zh-CN and cross-language subsets within 10% relative of the English subset; latency: feed p95 no worse than the stored baseline + 150 ms (live only). Rule in gates.ts: a metric computed from judge labels is reported untrusted until an audit file exists with judge-human weighted kappa >= 0.6.

INV-9 (due M1; expected to pass already) "$60,000,000 an hour" is not sorted as pay (normalize payPlausible, feed/ranking.ts annualPay). bundles.title: Role taxonomy precision, enrichment override and backfill; data quality (SM-2, SM-10; query labels of SM-11)
schema: RAJob.titleMatchScore Float? @db.Real (delivered by MKT-S0)
items:
[P0] A head noun matches alone only when it is the whole title; a modifier lexicon decides the rest (SM-2; strategy 2.3 step 2; MATCH 4.5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.ts: replace the one-entry CONTEXT_REDIRECTS (lines 132-144, the "architect" case added by FIX-3) and its namedOutright pass in matchTitle (lines 192-211) with a general rule. (1) HEAD_NOUNS: architect, designer, developer, engineer, analyst, consultant, manager, specialist, technician and the Chinese equivalents 设计师, 工程师, 顾问, 专员, 经理, 分析师. A role phrase that is exactly one head noun (today: "architect" on node architect, "developer" on software_engineer, "consultant" on management_consultant) scores only when the level-stripped title (stripLevelWords) equals that word; inside a longer title it scores 0. For Chinese, a phrase equal to a head word scores only when the compact title equals it. (2) MODIFIER_LEXICON: for each head noun a map from modifier token to role id, built at module load from the taxonomy itself (every level-3 phrase of the form "<modifiers> <head noun>" contributes its modifier tokens to its role) and extended by an explicit list: java, backend, cloud, data, ai, ml, security, solutions, enterprise, 后端, 云, 数据 plus the existing SOFTWARE_CONTEXT words (lines 117-125) select software_architect for "architect". A title "<modifiers> <head noun>" whose modifiers select exactly one role scores 0.85 for it; when they select several, the role sharing most tokens wins and a tie gives no deterministic match (enrichment decides). (3) Review the 143 one-word English phrases of level-3 roles (for example pm, pt, np, ae, controller, trainer, buyer, trader, rater, doctor) and mark the ambiguous ones aloneOnly in a constant with a one-line reason each; list them in the handoff. server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.v1.json: add the synonyms the rule needs (software_architect: solutions architect, cloud architect, data architect, security architect, ai architect, ml architect, microservices architect) and the mainland alias layer on existing nodes: 前端 / Web前端 / FE on the front-end role, 后端 / 服务端 on the back-end role, 管培生, 运营 families, 新媒体, 销售代表 variants on the nearest existing roles. No node id is added, removed or renamed (ids are stable; a new node is a taxonomy v2). Never copy a BOSS直聘 or 智联 category tree. matchTitle keeps its signature and returns the score it already returns (TitleMatch.score).
ACCEPT: Accepted when (SM-2): the architect cases pass: "Java Backend Architect", "Lead AI Architect", "Principal Architect - Machine Learning" and "Microservices Architect" resolve to software_architect (category software_engineering), "Landscape Architect", "Project Architect" and the bare title "Architect" to architect (category design). Added: "Senior Developer" still resolves to software_engineer (the head noun is the whole title after level words); "Sales Developer Representative" is not a software engineer; "UX Designer", "Interior Designer" and "Instructional Designer" land in three different roles; 前端开发工程师 and 服务端开发 resolve to the front-end and back-end roles; validateTaxonomy(taxonomy) returns no error.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.test.ts: one case per head noun in at least three disciplines, the Chinese head words, the tie rule, aloneOnly phrases; new taxonomy/idsFrozen.test.ts: validateTaxonomy returns no error and the set of node ids equals a frozen list (taxonomy.ts and taxonomy.test.ts are owned by the job-source bundle MKT-J1 in this phase and are not edited here; the existing taxonomy.test.ts must stay green).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.ts, server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.v1.json, server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/idsFrozen.test.ts

[P0] Enrichment may override a deterministic role scored under 0.9; the match score is stored (SM-2; strategy 2.3 step 2; MATCH 4.5 points 2)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/enrich/reconcile.ts, the block "Taxonomy: deterministic match wins; the model may only pick a candidate" (lines 399-411): today the model sets a role only when the row has none, so a wrong deterministic match is permanent. New rule: compute det = matchTitle(job.title, { limit: 1 })[0] inside reconcile (pure, no I/O). RAUserAffinity.titleWeights Json @default("{}") (delivered by MKT-S0)

FEED_QUERY_EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS: how long a request waits for the vector of a typed query before it runs without the dense leg (800)
items:
[P0] Three retrieval legs as SQL builders under the same scope and filter predicates (SM-7; strategy 2.1 point 3; MATCH 4.9 retrieval table)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/feed/hybridSql.ts (feed/sql.ts belongs to the Taiwan filter bundle of the job-source domain in this phase and is not edited: import scopePredicates, filterPredicates, FEED_COLUMNS, retrievalSql and qPredicateSql from it). Keep retrievalSql (sql.ts line 420) as leg A (recency). Add: lexicalLegSql(input, tsQuery): the same scopePredicates and filterPredicates, plus j."searchTsv" @@ to_tsquery('simple', $q), ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(j."searchTsv", to_tsquery('simple', $q)) DESC, j."postedAt" DESC NULLS LAST, j."id" DESC, LIMIT n; $q is built by toTsQuery of server/src/features/retrieval/segment.ts (the OR of the segmented tokens; the same function that segmented the document). denseLegSql(input, vectorLiteral, modelTag): the same predicates, JOIN "RAJobEmbedding" e ON e."jobId" = j."id" AND e."model" = $tag AND e."market" = $market, ORDER BY e."embedding" <=> $v::halfvec(1024), LIMIT n: an exact distance over the rows the filters leave, no approximate index. Both take from = the feed's age floor (floorOf: postedWithinDays or FEED_LIMITS.maxAgeDays 120), not the 14-day first window, so the best match that is not among the newest 400 can be found. The typed q: the q predicate of sql.ts (qPredicateSql, exported by MKT-S6) requires searchText ILIKE or a trigram match on the thin searchText (title + company + 10 skills). For the feed list build every leg with the filter fields minus q (the fields argument of retrievalSql and filterPredicates) and add wideQPredicateSql(q) from hybridSql.ts through the existing extra argument: (j."searchTsv" @@ to_tsquery('simple', $q) OR qPredicateSql(q)), so a term that appears only in the description is findable while rows not indexed yet (searchTsv null) still match through searchText; for input shorter than 3 Latin characters use qPredicateSql alone. The dense leg does not apply the q predicate (it is the leg that finds synonyms, adjacent titles and other languages); every other predicate applies to all legs. The count, sample and alert statements of sql.ts keep the narrow predicate in this phase (see sharedFiles: widening predicateFor is a one-line follow-up for the owner of sql.ts). Limits come from FEED_LIMITS.legLimit 200 and rrfK 60 (added by MKT-S6); retrievalLimit stays 400 as the cap of the union.
ACCEPT: The three statements differ only in their ordering clause, the join of the dense leg and the q rule; the snapshot test shows scope and filter predicates identical across legs for the same input; a job whose description (not title) names "Terraform" is returned for q = terraform once it has a search document; a row without a search document still matches a title query.
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/hybridSql.test.ts: inline snapshots of the two new builders for an empty filter set, a full intl set and a GoApply set; the wide q predicate; the short-query rule; parameters carry the ts query and the vector literal, never interpolated text.

[P0] Fusion by reciprocal rank inside the feed; consent rules; never an error when a leg is missing (SM-7 (Accepted when: Recall@200 gate; feed p95 within budget; without an embedding key legs A and B still answer); strategy 2.1 point 3, 2.5 row "Consent", 2.2 I8; MATCH 4.9)
CHANGE: server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.ts. New retrieveHybrid(ctx, filters, sort, state) used by firstWindow (lines 322-332) for the sorts recommended and best_fit, and for newest only when a query text is present; the deadline and highest_pay sorts and browse lists keep today's single statement. Legs run in parallel (Promise.all over repo.queryRows), 200 rows each: A = today's window (14 days, widened to 45 under 60 rows); B = lexical; C = dense. Query text for B and C: the typed q when present; else the relevance text (the residual of a natural-language search, next item); else, for a personalised user only, B uses the titles of the user's recent roles and their top skills (at most 24 tokens) and C uses the user vector (userVector of server/src/features/retrieval: resume, else intent). A typed q or relevance text is embedded at request time with purpose query through embedTexts, with an in-process cache keyed by sha1(text + model tag) for 10 minutes and a time limit of FEED_QUERY_EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS (800); on timeout, on an unavailable client (no key, budget, policy) or with no vector, leg C is simply left out. Fusion: score(job) = sum over the legs that returned it of 1 / (60 + rank in that leg); order by score, then newest; cap 400 (FEED_LIMITS.retrievalLimit). The fused position is kept on the candidate (retrievalRank) and is the tie-breaker of every sort after the existing ones; ranking itself is unchanged (fit through getFits, freshness, affinity, source quality). Sessions: jobIds are the ranked union; the refill of older windows (ensureFilled, lines 489-524) stays recency-keyed below leg A's boundary and skips ids already in the session. Consent (GoApply): without a live 个性化推荐 grant the list is not personalised: legs A and B with the typed query only, no user vector, no fit, and the order is date posted unless a query text is present, in which case it is the fused order of A and B (the FeedOrder value query_match, added to the contract by MKT-S6, so the page can say "Ordered by how closely the post matches your search": string jobs.order.queryMatch, shown where the recency notice is shown today in components/features/feed/JobsWorkspace.tsx); a query vector is requested only when aiAllowed(userId) holds, so with the AI consent off no embedding call is made at all (invariant 10). FEED_HYBRID=off returns to leg A only. The count, limiting-filters, alert-candidate and sample seams keep their single statements (they benefit from the widened q predicate only).
ACCEPT: With the three legs returning disjoint and overlapping fixtures the union is ordered by the reciprocal-rank sum and capped at 400; a job present in two legs outranks one present in a single leg at the same positions; with the embeddings client unavailable the result equals the fusion of A and B and no error is logged above info; a GoApply user without 个性化推荐 gets no user vector and no fit, and without the AI consent the counting fake embeddings client stays at zero; the precompute cron picks its candidates from the same list (feed preview) so its pick order is the fused order.
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.test.ts with fake repo rows per leg, a fake embeddings client and fake consent: fusion order and cap, the three query-text sources, cache and timeout, each consent case, FEED_HYBRID off, refill skips known ids; personalization.cn.test.ts extended; seams.test.ts (preview and alert seams unchanged in shape).

Numbers this plan had to choose because the strategy gives none; each is a named constant with an env or AppConfig override and is listed for the owner: logistics prior 50; calibration map from 500 pairs (strategy) and data-derived priors from 200 pairs; related evidence counts half of an item (the same value the scorer gives "partly"); SKILL_EMBED_MATCH_MIN 0.86 with a 0.03 margin; seen-and-skipped 5 / 7.5 / 10 points (the strategy says "up to 10"); wrong-title weight -0.25; model switch of the dense leg at 90% coverage; query-embedding wait 800 ms.
